newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to make big cut to soy estimate-source.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to make big cut to soy estimate-source.

text.p: Argentina's Agricultural Secretariat will announce it is reducing its forecast for 1997/98 soybean production by about one million tonnes Wednesday, a market source said Tuesday.
"They are going to cut the soybean forecast by a million tonnes. The figure is going to be under 12 million tonnes," the source, who did not want to be identified, told Reuters.

The Argentine government's Agricultural Secretariat is due to announce new crop forecasts at a monthly news conference Wednesday. It reduced its forecast for soybean output to 12.86 million tonnes from 13.5 million tonnes April 16.
Argentina's soybean crop was hit by a long drought. A U.S. agricultural attache reduced his soybean forecast to 12.5 million tonnes from 13.25 million tonnes in a report released May 7.
